tools.name: buscar_promocoes
tools.description: Lists AliExpress products with a real price drop, detected by our price history in the last 7 days (the seller's 'was' price does not count). tools.name: historico_de_preco
tools.description: Observed price series for an AliExpress product. Accepts the itemId or the product URL. Also returns the number of readings and days of tracking: with too little tracking there is no basis to claim a drop, and the response says so explicitly.

tools.name: quedas_de_preco
tools.description: Products whose price dropped at least 15% and $3 below the TYPICAL price of the last 14 days (median weighted by how long each price lasted — a flash sale only counts for the hours it ran), or that hit their lowest recorded price. Requires 3 days of tracking. Each product includes discount.certainty
